resources.string: Screenshots are blocked in OSHI to protect your conversations
Let contacts know I\'m on a restricted network
While traffic is disguised, your messages carry a small hint, end-to-end encrypted, so contacts know you may be on a censored or monitored network. Only they can see it.
This person uses OSHI\'s privacy disguise and is probably on a censored or monitored network. Reply normally: OSHI keeps disguising their side. Keep messages short; photos and videos may be slow.
